_help: Bosnia national team ticker. Edit on GitHub (pencil icon), then Commit. 'last.date' is the day it was played (YYYY-MM-DD): it shows for 45 days. 'next.kickoff' is the date and local time with the zone (+01:00 in winter, +02:00 in summer): on match day it says 'Match day!' and it disappears 3 hours after kickoff. Every text has a Bosnian (bs) and an English (en) version. To hide one line, delete its block; with neither, the ticker hides.
